The page for every stock

Your verdict, first.

Every stock opens with how it scores against your rules, so you see what fails before you read a number.

  • Price, growth, margin, ROCE and P/E at a glance
  • Next result date, from the exchanges
  • Choose what to show: performance, financial health, valuation, ownership, company
Raw data first

Twelve quarters, side by side.

Revenue, margins, profit, EPS and growth, with balance sheet, cash flow and who owns the company, as filed.

  • Quarterly and annual, with cash flow and balance sheet
  • Promoter, FII and DII holding, and pledge
  • Recent exchange filings, summarised
Beyond the filings

What the street expects.

Analyst targets, rating split and estimates for the next years and quarters, kept apart from reported results and clearly labelled.

  • Mean target, range and 90-day drift
  • Reported against consensus, with the surprise
  • Valuation against the stock's own history
Your tenets

Write your rules once.

Set the numbers you believe in. They drive two things, so you never set them twice.

  • The screener. Which stocks pass, in Analytics and on every stock page.
  • Your positions. How big a holding may grow, when to trim, and your sector limit.
  • Defaults are ready. Change only what you disagree with.
